title: Relics and Archaeology
answer: Rings and amulets have distinct bounded energy attunements. Soulstones and the Soul Matrix are persistent auxiliary energy reservoirs that pay an otherwise unaffordable cast atomically. The Ritual Dagger converts four health into 80 existing magic energy. The five heart relics provide healing, energy, absorption, or a five-minute death ward; the Philosopher's Stone performs protected transmutation; Lodestones bind Miniportal destinations; the Flute commands aligned guardians. The Empyrean Jewel pays a fixed surcharge to override every consent-gated ability but never safe zones. Malignember reduces only explicit destructive-magic energy costs. Arcane energy dusts, salts, fossils, jewels, stones and ritual vessels contribute bounded Crucible XP. Representative relics occur additively in exploration loot.
